issues.detail: The new constant DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT=16 added in backward_codecs Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat duplicates the same constant from core Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat. If the core constant ever changes (it shouldn't for an on-disk format, but still), the two will drift silently. Add a comment pinning it to the legacy on-disk value or import the core constant.

issues.description: Public NAME constant downgraded to package-private may break external codec consumers
issues.detail: Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat.NAME and Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat.NAME were public static final String and are now package-private. External code (e.g., Elasticsearch/OpenSearch plugins) commonly references these NAME constants. Even when moving to backward_codecs, removing public visibility on these is a binary-incompatible API removal, not just a deprecation.

issues.description: OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues protected->package-private breaks subclassing across packages
issues.detail: All `protected` fields on OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues were changed to package-private. Even within backward_codecs this class still has a `public` subclass DenseOffHeapVectorValues, and external code may have subclassed for testing/integration. Dropping `protected` removes inheritance access. If intentional, the class itself should likely become final or package-private.

Both Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat and Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat lost their @Deprecated annotations during the move to backward_codecs. Convention in this repo (see other backward_codecs formats) is to keep @Deprecated so downstream users see IDE warnings that this is a read-only legacy format. Removing it makes them look like normal first-class APIs again.

issues.description: fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException but constructor still accepts ExecutorService
issues.detail: Lucene99HnswScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat keeps the 7-arg constructor accepting numMergeWorkers and ExecutorService, validates them, but immediately discards them since fieldsWriter throws. Users passing a valid executor will get a confusing UOE only at write time. Either deprecate/simplify the constructor signature, or fail-fast in the constructor with a clearer message that writing is unsupported.

issues.description: CHANGES.txt entry edits a 10.x line that already shipped
issues.detail: The CHANGES.txt edit modifies an existing GITHUB#15169 bullet under New Features. If that line was part of an already-released version, retroactively editing release notes is discouraged; this addition (15223) should be its own bullet in the unreleased section.

review.summary: This PR moves the legacy Lucene99 scalar-quantized formats to backward_codecs and disables their writers. The mechanical move is mostly clean, but several public API constants (NAME) and protected fields are silently dropped to package-private, which is binary-incompatible for external consumers like Elasticsearch. The @Deprecated annotations are also removed, conflicting with the read-only intent. The HNSW format constructor still accepts ExecutorService/numMergeWorkers that are now ignored, producing late UOE failures. Minor concern around editing the existing 15169 CHANGES.txt bullet rather than adding a new one.
